card.fact_statement: Luhaga Mpina was a candidate for the Alliance for Change and Transparency (ACT) who was barred from running.
card.source_span: On 15 September, candidate Luhaga Mpina of Alliance for Change and Transparency (ACT) was also barred from running

target_qa_variants.question: 2025年のタンザニア総選挙で立候補を禁止された、変革と透明性のための同盟の候補者は誰ですか？
target_qa_variants.source_span: On 15 September, candidate Luhaga Mpina of Alliance for Change and Transparency (ACT) was also barred from running
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Alliance for Change and Transparency' literally as '変革と透明性のための同盟' and 'Luhaga Mpina' as 'ルハガ・ムピナ'.

backtranslation_en.question: Who is the candidate of the Alliance for Change and Transparency who was banned from running in the 2025 Tanzanian general election?
